classification: server-only names and descriptions; no values

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Server-only PostgreSQL connection; no URL query. TLS CA is supplied separately by the existing owner service entry
variables.scope: owner service only; configure directly on server, never source/chat/APK

variables.name: C3_DATABASE_CA_FILE
variables.purpose: Readable managed PostgreSQL CA file; TLS verification remains required

variables.name: C3_OWNER_HTTPS_ORIGIN
variables.purpose: Owner-selected exact public HTTPS origin matching its trusted TLS certificate; no proxy-derived origin
variables.scope: owner service; public origin, not an approval flag

variables.name: C3_OWNER_HTTPS_PORT
variables.purpose: Direct TLS listener unprivileged port, 8443 by default; public routing must match approved origin

variables.name: C3_OWNER_TLS_KEY_FILE
variables.purpose: Path to server-only TLS private material, not its contents
variables.scope: owner service only; owner configures outside repository

variables.name: C3_OWNER_TLS_CERT_FILE
variables.purpose: Path to trusted HTTPS certificate chain matching origin

variables.name: C3_JUPITER_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Authenticated Jupiter Swap V2 builder access

variables.name: C3_MAINNET_RPC_PRIMARY_URL
variables.purpose: Reviewed primary HTTPS Mainnet RPC endpoint

variables.name: C3_MAINNET_RPC_SECONDARY_URL
variables.purpose: Independently operated secondary HTTPS Mainnet RPC endpoint

variables.name: C3_MAINNET_RPC_PRIMARY_OPERATOR_ID
variables.purpose: Reviewed public operator identity for the primary provider

variables.name: C3_MAINNET_RPC_SECONDARY_OPERATOR_ID
variables.purpose: Reviewed public operator identity for the secondary provider
